paragraphs.text: Cloudspire City is a city on the plane of Kylem . It is best known as the home of the famous Valor's Reach stadium, the largest and most prestigious arena on Kylem.

Cloudspire is a center for sport and spectacle, attracting competitors and spectators from all over Kylem who come to test their skills or witness the biggest matches. The city is home to the wealthiest class of beings on Kylem, the elves , who are heavily involved in its entertainment and arena events. The city has a reputation for high-speed contests and organized combat sports, all part of the team-based competitions that define Kylem's culture.
